column.name: report_sql
column.value: select mc.account_no as "CustomerID", TO_CHAR(mc.created_on_utc, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Date Opened", mc.display_name as "Account Name", msa.account_no as "Account No", msa.account_balance_derived as "Account Balance", mcv.code_value as "Account Tier", concat(msp."name", ' ', msp.currency_code) as "Account Type", rev.enum_value as "Account Status", concat(ma.firstname, ' ', ma.lastname) as "Account Opened By", ii."ID Number" as "BVN", mc.mobile_no as "Mobile", mc.email_address as "Email", concat(mad.address_line_1, ' ', mad.address_line_2, ' ', mad.city) as "Address", ms.display_name as "Account Officer" from m_client mc left join m_savings_account msa on mc.default_savings_account = msa.id left join m_savings_product msp on msa.product_id = msp.id left join r_enum_value rev on rev.enum_id = msa.status_enum and rev.enum_name = 'status_enum' left join m_appuser ma on ma.id = msa.created_by left join m_code_value mcv on mc.client_classification_cv_id = mcv.id left join m_client_address mca on mc.id = mca.client_id and mca.address_type_id = 18 left join m_address mad on mad.id = mca.address_id left join m_staff ms on msa.field_officer_id = ms.id left join "Identity Information" ii on ii.client_id = mc.id and ii."Identity Types_cd_Identity Type" = (select id from m_code_value mcvb where mcvb.code_id = (select id from m_code where code_name = 'Identity Types') and mcvb.code_value = 'BVN') where (msa.product_id = ${savingsProductId} or -1 = ${savingsProductId}) and (mc.created_on_utc >= '${startDate}' or '${startDate}' is null) and (mc.created_on_utc <= '${endDate}' or '${endDate}' is null)
